g.text: YouTube Clone & Synchronized Watch Party Platform
Hybrid Architecture: Next.js 16 PWA • Socket.io Watch Sync (<250ms) • WebRTC P2P Mesh • Cloud Media Pipeline
• Local WebM download without server rendering
• Auto-shifts auth method based on security context
• Offline downloads with daily tier quota checks
Forces client resync ONLY when drift > 250ms
• Dynamic peer cleanup & graceful disconnect recovery
• Multer chunked streams piped to Cloudinary
Bypasses server RAM to prevent crash bottlenecks
• Community moderation: auto-purges if dislikes > limit
FLOW A: LOW-LATENCY WATCH PARTY DRIFT COMPENSATION
→ Micro-drift < 250ms ignored to prevent jarring micro-stutter; hard sync triggered if lag exceeds threshold.
FLOW B: ZERO-RAM CHUNKED CLOUD MEDIA PIPELINE
→ Bypasses server memory by streaming directly to Cloudinary storage, preventing server crashes under heavy load.
